transcript: A robot can offer a cup and still miss the person. At UT Austin, a federally funded research center began its award term this month. The researchers describe a goal: a robot could adjust its reach to a person. The point is to bring the drink where that person can reach it. The harder test is sharing homes and care settings over time. The university pictures a mug handoff in a simulated apartment. Its announcement says consent and opt-out procedures will be developed. It reports no care results. The community is meant to help shape where and how a robot is deployed. The useful handoff ends within reach. The research still has to get there.
